tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search Seduction.lk, a Sri Lankan online store for authentic skincare, hair care and beauty products, by product name, brand, ingredient, skin type, concern or a need in plain words (e.g. 'niacinamide serum', 'sunscreen for oily skin', 'something that won't break me out'). Returns products with pric

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Full details of one Seduction.lk product: description, price in LKR, stock, brand, categories, ingredients, skin types and concerns it is for, rating and its link. Use the id or the slug from search_products.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Seduction.lk's product categories (e.g. Skin Care > Serums > Brightening Serums), with product counts.

tools.name: list_brands
tools.description: Brands sold on Seduction.lk, optionally filtered by name, with product counts.

tools.name: get_store_info
tools.description: How buying from Seduction.lk works: delivery areas, times and charges, payment methods, cancellations and returns, and how to contact customer service.

tools.name: create_cart_link
tools.description: Build a Seduction.lk link that opens the store with these products in the shopper's cart, ready for them to check out themselves. Products must be in stock. Nothing is ordered or charged.
